concerns.text: Principle II (Verified Accuracy) requires every external citation to be verified. The plan lists OpenML ID 42123 and a NIST DOI but provides no verified URLs in the “Verified datasets” block, violating the constitution.

Inconsistent terminology for the grouping identifier: the plan (and data‑model) use `pairing_id`, while the specification (FR‑014) refers to `material_pair_id`. This mismatch can cause traceability errors.
